title: Practice 2: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

**идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
**ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
